I am an older woman with only a small piece of land, so I must be careful with my money. The rains in our area are usually good enough for my cassava, and I have some chicken manure from the compound to put on the soil. I will use the cuttings I kept from last season and do the weeding with my children and grandchildren, as hiring workers is too costly for this small plot.
